document.title: AI-Enhanced Public Procurement Platform
document.description: With my team, built an MVP of an AI and blockchain-powered platform for transparent and efficient public procurement processes.
insights: Combining AI and blockchain technologies can create more transparent procurement processes
Machine learning can improve resource allocation in public sector
Public sector innovation requires careful balance of efficiency and accountability
Cross-functional teams enable comprehensive problem-solving in complex domains

body.raw:
Built an AI and blockchain-powered platform for transparent and efficient public procurement processes during the AI for Connectivity Hackathon. The solution aimed to reduce corruption and improve resource allocation in public sector procurement.

Key features included automated bid evaluation, fraud detection, and transparent audit trails. The platform demonstrated how emerging technologies can be leveraged to serve public good while maintaining accountability.
